info.title: Nuban Generator
info.description: Generates a check digit that makes a 10 digit NUBAN account number.

/generate.summary: This API is used to generate NUBAN compliant account numbers.
/generate.description: This API is used to generate NUBAN compliant account numbers.

post.summary: This API is used to generate NUBAN compliant account numbers.
post.description: Accepts a 9-digit account number and a bank code, then generates the check digit to produce a valid 10-digit NUBAN compliant account number.

requestBody.description: The request payload containing the base account number and bank code required to generate a NUBAN compliant account number.

RequestBody.description: Request payload containing the base account number and bank code used to generate a NUBAN compliant 10-digit account number.

reqId.description: A unique request identifier for tracking this NUBAN generation request. Maximum length is 10 characters.

accountNo.description: The 9-digit base account number for which the NUBAN check digit will be generated.

bankCode.description: The CBN-assigned 3-digit bank sort code used in the NUBAN check digit calculation. Currently only code 221 is supported.

ResponsePayload.description: The standard response envelope returned by the API on a successful NUBAN account number generation request.

transactionDetails.description: An object containing the details of the generated NUBAN account number, including the request ID and bank code used.

reqId.description: The unique request identifier that was submitted in the original generation request.

bankCode.description: The CBN-assigned 3-digit bank sort code used during the NUBAN check digit calculation.

nubanGeneratedAccntNo.description: The fully generated 10-digit NUBAN compliant account number including the computed check digit.

responseMsg.description: A human-readable message describing the outcome of the NUBAN generation request.

responseCode.description: A numeric code indicating the result of the request. A value of 200 indicates successful generation.

41.description: Unauthorized. The client ID or secret provided in the request headers is invalid or missing.

schema.description: Error response returned when the supplied authentication credentials are invalid or absent.

httpCode.description: The HTTP status code for the authentication error.

httpMessage.description: A short label describing the HTTP error status.

moreInformation.description: Additional context explaining why the authorization request failed.

55.description: Service Currently Unavailable. The downstream service is temporarily unable to process the request.

schema.description: Error response returned when the service is temporarily unavailable or unreachable.

responsecode.description: The response code indicating service unavailability.

responseMsg.description: A message describing the service availability error.

99.description: Bad Request. The request payload is invalid, such as an unsupported bank code or malformed account number.

schema.description: Error response returned when the request payload fails validation, such as an invalid or unsupported bank code.

responseMsg.description: A message describing the nature of the bad request error.

responseCode.description: A code identifying the specific validation failure that occurred during request processing.

00.description: Successful. The NUBAN check digit has been generated and the full 10-digit account number is returned.

OAuth.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow used to authorize API access. A bearer token must be obtained and passed with each request.
